title: secp256k1-native has a compiler-induced timing side channel in scalar multiplication (CVE-2026-63410)
description: The secp256k1-native library versions prior to 0.18.0 contain a compiler-induced timing side channel in the constant-time scalar multiplication function Point#mul. This occurs because GCC 15.2 at optimization level -O2 reconstructs a branch from a branchless select operation, causing secret-dependent conditional jumps that leak timing information about the secret scalar. This leak can allow attackers with timing access to statistically recover bits of private keys or nonces. The issue is fixed in version 0.18.0 by introducing a value barrier to prevent the compiler from reconstructing branches. Users should upgrade to 0.18.0 or use a compiler/flags that do not cause this behavior. The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 5.9 (medium severity).
